entries.claim: Revised Polish wording basis for the opening act of adoration. The historical clause ‘Kłaniam się Tobie, Boże nieskończony’ is revised against the Latin to express devotion, hiddenness and the divine-nature title, without the historical addition ‘nieskończony’. The page does not print the revised wording verbatim or supply the whole present hymn.

Revised Polish wording basis for the single saving drop of the blood. The printed ‘Której kropelka z grzechu wszelakiego’ supplies the relative blood reference and drop; the revision removes the diminutive, restores explicit one and expresses the Latin saving infinitive adjectivally. The from-sin phrase remains with its Latin segment s24. This is not verbatim retention or a whole-hymn basis.

Revised Polish wording basis for the single drop’s capacity to cleanse the world from every sin. The printed ‘Oczyścić może każdego grzesznego’ supplies cleansing and ability; the revision restores the Latin whole world instead of every sinner and places the complete from-sin phrase here. This is not verbatim retention or a whole-hymn basis.
